digest.component_or_area: dependency management and Bedrock SDK integration
propositions: Bedrock Converse outputConfig (native structured output) is rejected client-side by botocore 1.40.61 with ParamValidationError before network calls; the feature requires botocore >= 1.43
Current dependency resolution locks botocore at 1.40.61 due to a diamond: [eval] extra pulls inspect-ai → aioboto3 → aiobotocore capping boto3 < 1.40.62, conflicting with pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]
Explicit floor constraints botocore>=1.43.0 and boto3>=1.43.0 must be added to pyproject.toml alongside pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock] dependency
The existing [tool.uv] conflicts block already forks eval vs bedrock/dev resolution; the new floor should resolve without modifying the conflict fork logic
The dev/bedrock resolution path must contain botocore >= 1.43, while the eval fork must remain installable independently
